title: 醫療裝置人因工程驗證
summary: 以「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Completion rate hiding critical use errors.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜需求證據覆蓋：機制與界面

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」。畫出「來源事件 → 時間與識別 → 傳輸儲存 → 處理版本 → 可重播證據」並圈出與「需求證據覆蓋」有關的介面。將 100*verified/required 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：已通過且具有版本一致證據的需求數除以總需求數。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。

steps.title: 單元1｜需求證據覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Requirement evidence coverage: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」的「需求證據覆蓋」採以下合成教學值：verified=8 requirements；required=10 requirements。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 100*verified/required；獨立基準為 80 %。把 verified 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 88 %。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence, use synthetic inputs for Requirement evidence coverage: verified=8 requirements；required=10 requirements. Check dimensions before evaluating 100*verified/required; the independent benchmark is 80 %. Increase verified by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 88 %. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: verified增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 8 %。覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 8 %. Coverage is not quality probability; critical failures must remain separately visible.
steps.failure: 任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤；覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。
steps.failureEn: Completion rate hiding critical use errors; Coverage is not quality probability; critical failures must remain separately visible.
steps.check: 原值重算與 80 % 相符；10%案例與 88 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 80 % at baseline and 88 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（%）？
quiz.explanation: 按 100*verified/required 逐項代入，結果為 80；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into 100*verified/required gives 80; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜需求證據覆蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Requirement evidence coverage: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」設計「需求證據覆蓋」的獨立驗證：以合成需求矩陣找出缺測、失敗與版本不符，三者不得算入通過數。 以匿名合成紀錄回放正常、缺值、重複和版本不符四種情境，核對預期結果。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence, independently verify Requirement evidence coverage: Find untested, failed and version-mismatched rows in a synthetic matrix and exclude them from passes. Replay anonymous synthetic normal, missing, duplicate and version-mismatch records against expected outcomes. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Completion rate hiding critical use errors rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤；覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。
steps.failureEn: Completion rate hiding critical use errors; Coverage is not quality probability; critical failures must remain separately visible.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Coverage is not quality probability; critical failures must remain separately visible.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 保留原始資料並執行：以合成需求矩陣找出缺測、失敗與版本不符，三者不得算入通過數。
只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Find untested, failed and version-mismatched rows in a synthetic matrix and exclude them from passes.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。」。
quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Coverage is not quality probability; critical failures must remain separately visible.

steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Requirement evidence coverage: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤」。以本單元「需求證據覆蓋」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以合成需求矩陣找出缺測、失敗與版本不符，三者不得算入通過數。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Completion rate hiding critical use errors. For Requirement evidence coverage, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Find untested, failed and version-mismatched rows in a synthetic matrix and exclude them from passes. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤」不是單靠 80 % 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 80 % alone cannot exclude Completion rate hiding critical use errors; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤；覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。
steps.failureEn: Completion rate hiding critical use errors; Coverage is not quality probability; critical failures must remain separately visible.
steps.check: 交付單元1的五項證據包；清楚寫出「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 1, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence and retaining failed cases.

steps.observation: speed增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.1 mm。加速度、隨機抖動和預測控制不在此簡式內。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.1 mm. Acceleration, timing jitter and predictive control are outside this simple model.
steps.failure: 任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤；加速度、隨機抖動和預測控制不在此簡式內。
steps.failureEn: Completion rate hiding critical use errors; Acceleration, timing jitter and predictive control are outside this simple model.
steps.check: 原值重算與 1 mm 相符；10%案例與 1.1 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 1 mm at baseline and 1.1 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（mm）？
quiz.explanation: 按 speed*delay 逐項代入，結果為 1；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into speed*delay gives 1; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元2｜延遲造成位移：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Latency displacement: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」設計「延遲造成位移」的獨立驗證：以共同時間基準記錄命令和量測，將固定延遲與抖動分開。 以匿名合成紀錄回放正常、缺值、重複和版本不符四種情境，核對預期結果。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence, independently verify Latency displacement: Timestamp commands and measurements on one clock, separating fixed latency from jitter. Replay anonymous synthetic normal, missing, duplicate and version-mismatch records against expected outcomes. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Completion rate hiding critical use errors rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤；加速度、隨機抖動和預測控制不在此簡式內。
steps.failureEn: Completion rate hiding critical use errors; Acceleration, timing jitter and predictive control are outside this simple model.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「加速度、隨機抖動和預測控制不在此簡式內。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Acceleration, timing jitter and predictive control are outside this simple model.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：以共同時間基準記錄命令和量測，將固定延遲與抖動分開。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Timestamp commands and measurements on one clock, separating fixed latency from jitter.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「加速度、隨機抖動和預測控制不在此簡式內。」。

steps.title: 單元2｜延遲造成位移：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Latency displacement: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤」。以本單元「延遲造成位移」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以共同時間基準記錄命令和量測，將固定延遲與抖動分開。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Completion rate hiding critical use errors. For Latency displacement, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Timestamp commands and measurements on one clock, separating fixed latency from jitter. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤」不是單靠 1 mm 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 1 mm alone cannot exclude Completion rate hiding critical use errors; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 任務完成率掩蓋關鍵操作錯誤；加速度、隨機抖動和預測控制不在此簡式內。
steps.failureEn: Completion rate hiding critical use errors; Acceleration, timing jitter and predictive control are outside this simple model.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「模擬使用任務、關鍵錯誤與介面證據」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Simulated use tasks, critical errors and interface evidence and retaining failed cases.
